title: Unit – 5 : Session – 7 : SLO – 1  |  ARM Processor Modes and Banked Registers
sections: 1. B. User Mode — the unprivileged mode for normal application execution.
2. B. FIQ (Fast Interrupt Request) — handles fast interrupts, with extra banked registers for low-latency response.
3. C. R13, R14, SPSR — exception modes bank the stack pointer, link register and saved program status register (FIQ additionally banks R8–R12).
